title: Riverbend Uninsured Discount Schedule for the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
The Riverbend uninsured discount schedule fixes, for each patient class of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), the percent of gross charges deducted for a self-pay account, the lower percent used for elective non-covered services, and whether an insured patient's non-covered-service liability can receive the uninsured discount at all.

## Schedule terms

- **Uninsured discount percent**: the percent of gross charges deducted for a self-pay financial-class account on medically necessary or emergency services, posted at final bill.
- **Elective uninsured discount percent**: the percent of gross charges deducted for a self-pay account whose services are classified elective non-covered.
- **Discount on an insured patient's non-covered services**: whether an insured patient's non-covered-service liability line receives the uninsured discount percent (yes or no by patient class).
- **Rounding**: every discount amount is rounded half-up to the cent on the computed USD amount; this holds for all seven patient classes.

## Percentages by patient class

| Patient class | Uninsured discount percent | Elective uninsured discount percent | Insured patient's non-covered services eligible | Rounding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 40 | 20 | yes | half-up to the cent |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 55 | 25 | yes | half-up to the cent |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 45 | 20 | yes | half-up to the cent |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 45 | 20 | yes | half-up to the cent |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 50 | 25 | no | half-up to the cent |
| Observation Stay Account | 50 | 25 | no | half-up to the cent |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 55 | 25 | no | half-up to the cent |

## Points of reading

- The four outpatient and emergency classes in the upper rows are the patient classes that grant the uninsured discount on an insured patient's non-covered services; Outpatient Surgery, Observation Stay and Inpatient Admission accounts do not.
- *Rounding illustration (hypothetical amount).* A computed discount of 123.456 is rounded half-up to 123.46; a computed discount of 123.454 is rounded to 123.45.
